title: ServiceMaster of Ottawa
description: svmottawa.ca  ServiceMaster of Ottawa Canadian property restoration and commercial cleaning company (legal entity 1351120 Ontario Inc.), a ServiceMaster franchise since 1969 — owned since 2006 by John Cooke. HQ at 180 Wescar Lane, Ottawa (Carp/Richmond), ~140 staff, 24/7/365 emergency service across the National Capital Region. Core: water/fire/mold remediation, asbestos removal, reconstruction, odor control, janitorial — backed by IICRC techs, HCRA license B62544, Tarion, WSIB+liability, Restore 365/Xactimate. Record: 40,000+ customers served; Cooke won ServiceMaster's "Brand Ambassador of the Year" 2026, "Mid-Market Business of the Year" (Ottawa Chamber, 2008). Reputation mixed (3.8–4.3/5, 313+ reviews) — excellent on small jobs and named techs (Ryan Potestio, Jeff Jerome)
